_comment: Read confinement, by surface. Steps 2 and 4 (bash) are enforced by service/confined-runner.sh and pass. Step 1 (the fs read tool) is the known-open gap: dsh-fs-sandbox does not restrict observation, and closing it needs a ctx.fs provider. This scenario is deliberately left failing on that step — it is the record of an open gap, not a passing test.
